name: Cost Calculator Builder
author: Stylemix

sections.description:
WP Cost Calculator is a simple and powerful tool that lets you create price estimation forms. Easily give your clients information about your services and product costs.

This tool helps you build any type of estimation form in minutes. The Calculator WordPress plugin has its own drag-and-drop form builder. You can create an unlimited number of calculation forms and embed them into any page or post with no coding.

⭐ Cost Calculator PRO
⭐ Live Demo
⭐ Documentation
⭐ Facebook Community

Our calculator plugin for WordPress is intuitive and beginner-friendly. Cost Calculator is especially suitable if your services or products have variable costs.

🎯 Perfect for:
Freelancers, creative agencies, local services, salons, repair shops, real estate pros, educational institutions, and more.

If you need to make a price calculator to estimate your project costs, this tool is for you. Need a loan calculator? A service quote form? An order estimator? This plugin can handle it all—fast.

Let WP Cost Calculator become your virtual assistant and boost conversions on your website.

🧩 10 Core WordPress Calculator Elements:
○ Text field
○ Formula
○ Quantity field
○ Dropdown
○ Switch toggle
○ Radio select
○ Checkbox
○ Basic slider
○ HTML
○ Divider

🚀 More advanced elements in Cost Calculator Pro:
○ Multi range

🌟Cost Calculator Builder PRO Features

The Premium version includes the following features:

○ Analytics – See how each calculator and field performs with views, submissions, and revenue stats in one place.
○ Conditional system – Show/hide or enable/disable fields based on user input.
○ Repeater – Let users repeat a group of fields to calculate costs for multiple items, people, or services.
○ Group Field – Group fields together and display them conditionally based on selected options.
○ Validated Form – Lets users create forms with fields for emails, numbers, and URLs.
○ Email Templates – Send personalized emails to clients after form submissions.
○ WooCommerce Integration – Let customers calculate the price of your WooCommerce products depending on cost calculator variables and custom formulas.
○ Page Breaker – Improve long forms by splitting them into multiple steps.
○ PayPal – Get paid online using PayPal accounts.
○ Stripe – Accepts payments with credit/debit cards and digital wallets.
○ Razorpay – Add support for various Indian payment methods.
○ Cash payments – Give flexibility to customers with cash payment options.
○ File Upload – Set a module where the users attach any type of file to the calculator.
○ Sticky Calculator – Add a floating button or sticky banner that keeps the calculator visible as users scroll.
○ Discounts – Offer discounts for a specific period or by using a promo code.
○ Geolocation – Automatically detect the user’s location or allow them to calculate cost by selecting two points on the map.
○ PDF Entries – Generate downloadable and printable PDF invoices from user submissions.
○ Orders Dashboard – Track and manage your customers’ orders in Dashboard.
○ Order Form Manager – Collect and process customer order details.
○ Contact Form 7 Integration – Seamless communication with your customers.
○ Custom Webhooks – Automate business workflows with Zapier, Make, IFTTT, and more.
○ reCAPTCHA – Protect forms from spam and bots using Google reCAPTCHA.
○ Date Picker – Add a compact calendar with a range of days to your calculator.
○ Time Picker – Allow to choose a specific time or a time range to provide a service or make an appointment.
○ Multi-Range Slider – Let users select a range of values using two adjustable handles.
○ Image Dropdown – Show dropdown options with images for more visual selections.
○ Share Quote Form – Send a generated invoice/order (after calculations) to a client’s email in one click.
○ Image Checkbox – Improve checkbox options by showing images next to each item.
○ Image Radio – Similar to image checkboxes, but only one option can be selected.

Explore the Plugin Demo here

You can assign values to any form element, and WP Cost Calculator will instantly calculate the total. You also have full control to create custom formulas using addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division. Easily embed your calculators anywhere using shortcodes.

Don’t worry about customization! Adjust colors, fonts, and background freely to match your website’s style and brand without limitations.

100+ Ready-made Form Templates

Cost Calculator plugin for WordPress comes with a library of form templates. They make it easy for various businesses to create, edit, save and use contact, booking, payment order, or pricing form without designing from scratch.

There are over 100 ready-made form templates sorted by business type that you can import and use right away. Whether you’re selling custom products or services with flexible pricing, this calculator plugin helps you create forms tailored to what you offer:

– And even more!

Explore the ready-to-use Templates page and try them on our live demo.

Start building quote calculators that convert visitors into paying clients faster and smarter with WP Cost Calculator.

Cost Calculator Community on Facebook

You can visit our Cost Calculator group on Facebook to get the latest updates, engage with other users, and share your thoughts.

sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Please find more details on Plugin Installation in documentation
  4. Set Up Page in Menu -> Calculator Builder.

Also, you can import the demo sample using Tools -> Import -> WordPress Import.
Demo sample XML file included in plugin archive.

How can I report security bugs?

You can report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team help validate, triage and handle any security vulnerabilities. Report a security vulnerability.

description:
WP Cost Calculator is a simple and powerful tool that lets you create price estimation forms. Easily give your clients information about your services and product costs.

This tool helps you build any type of estimation form in minutes. The Calculator WordPress plugin has its own drag-and-drop form builder. You can create an unlimited number of calculation forms and embed them into any page or post with no coding.

⭐ Cost Calculator PRO
⭐ Live Demo
⭐ Documentation
⭐ Facebook Community

Our calculator plugin for WordPress is intuitive and beginner-friendly. Cost Calculator is especially suitable if your services or products have variable costs.

🎯 Perfect for:
Freelancers, creative agencies, local services, salons, repair shops, real estate pros, educational institutions, and more.

If you need to make a price calculator to estimate your project costs, this tool is for you. Need a loan calculator? A service quote form? An order estimator? This plugin can handle it all—fast.

Let WP Cost Calculator become your virtual assistant and boost conversions on your website.

🧩 10 Core WordPress Calculator Elements:
○ Text field
○ Formula
○ Quantity field
○ Dropdown
○ Switch toggle
○ Radio select
○ Checkbox
○ Basic slider
○ HTML
○ Divider

🚀 More advanced elements in Cost Calculator Pro:
○ Multi range

○ Image radio
○ Date picker
○ Time picker
○ Repeater
○ Group
○ Geolocation

🎨 Element Style options:

Show input options in multiple formats—vertically or horizontally.

🌟Cost Calculator Builder PRO Features

The Premium version includes the following features:

○ Analytics – See how each calculator and field performs with views, submissions, and revenue stats in one place.
○ Conditional system – Show/hide or enable/disable fields based on user input.
○ Repeater – Let users repeat a group of fields to calculate costs for multiple items, people, or services.
○ Group Field – Group fields together and display them conditionally based on selected options.
○ Validated Form – Lets users create forms with fields for emails, numbers, and URLs.
○ Email Templates – Send personalized emails to clients after form submissions.
○ WooCommerce Integration – Let customers calculate the price of your WooCommerce products depending on cost calculator variables and custom formulas.
○ Page Breaker – Improve long forms by splitting them into multiple steps.
○ PayPal – Get paid online using PayPal accounts.
○ Stripe – Accepts payments with credit/debit cards and digital wallets.
○ Razorpay – Add support for various Indian payment methods.
○ Cash payments – Give flexibility to customers with cash payment options.
○ File Upload – Set a module where the users attach any type of file to the calculator.
○ Sticky Calculator – Add a floating button or sticky banner that keeps the calculator visible as users scroll.
○ Discounts – Offer discounts for a specific period or by using a promo code.
○ Geolocation – Automatically detect the user’s location or allow them to calculate cost by selecting two points on the map.
○ PDF Entries – Generate downloadable and printable PDF invoices from user submissions.
○ Orders Dashboard – Track and manage your customers’ orders in Dashboard.
○ Order Form Manager – Collect and process customer order details.
○ Contact Form 7 Integration – Seamless communication with your customers.
○ Custom Webhooks – Automate business workflows with Zapier, Make, IFTTT, and more.
○ reCAPTCHA – Protect forms from spam and bots using Google reCAPTCHA.
○ Date Picker – Add a compact calendar with a range of days to your calculator.
○ Time Picker – Allow to choose a specific time or a time range to provide a service or make an appointment.
○ Multi-Range Slider – Let users select a range of values using two adjustable handles.
○ Image Dropdown – Show dropdown options with images for more visual selections.
○ Share Quote Form – Send a generated invoice/order (after calculations) to a client’s email in one click.
○ Image Checkbox – Improve checkbox options by showing images next to each item.
○ Image Radio – Similar to image checkboxes, but only one option can be selected.

Explore the Plugin Demo here

You can assign values to any form element, and WP Cost Calculator will instantly calculate the total. You also have full control to create custom formulas using addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division. Easily embed your calculators anywhere using shortcodes.

Don’t worry about customization! Adjust colors, fonts, and background freely to match your website’s style and brand without limitations.

100+ Ready-made Form Templates

Cost Calculator plugin for WordPress comes with a library of form templates. They make it easy for various businesses to create, edit, save and use contact, booking, payment order, or pricing form without designing from scratch.

There are over 100 ready-made form templates sorted by business type that you can import and use right away. Whether you’re selling custom products or services with flexible pricing, this calculator plugin helps you create forms tailored to what you offer:
– Printing Service

Explore the ready-to-use Templates page and try them on our live demo.
